justice der.bio: Canadian guitarist, singer-songwriter and producer Justice Der is based in Toronto, where his fluid instrumental style blends jazz, hip-hop, alternative and ambient music. He first built a large online following through guitar covers before expanding into original projects and collaborations with artists including Rachel Bobbitt.

jesse gold.bio: Toronto native Jesse Gold is an R&B-pop singer-songwriter, guitarist and producer whose polished, soulful work pairs modern R&B songwriting with musicianship developed from an early age. His catalogue includes the We’ll Be Fine EP and collaborations with artists including JP Saxe, Craig David and Babyface.

jon kabongo.bio: Toronto-born and raised rapper Jon Kabongo is a lyricist whose music moves between punchline-heavy boom bap, melodic Afrobeat and more reflective hip-hop. Raised by Congolese immigrant parents in downtown Toronto, he brings that cultural background and his city upbringing into his writing.

grimace love.bio: Scarborough rapper Grimace Love is a veteran of Toronto’s underground hip-hop scene and a longtime member of the Monolith collective. His solo work carries the rugged boom-bap sound associated with the crew while giving more room to his raspy delivery, storytelling and personal writing.

bella white.bio: Calgary-born Canadian-American singer-songwriter and guitarist Bella White blends bluegrass, country, folk and contemporary Americana. Raised in Alberta around traditional music, she developed a modern songwriting voice while staying closely connected to the Appalachian and bluegrass sounds that shaped her early playing.

josh sahunta.bio: Edmonton singer-songwriter and multi-instrumentalist Josh Sahunta is a Canadian R&B-pop artist whose melodic, emotionally direct writing has crossed into television placements and adult contemporary audiences. His album To Be Loved Vol. I earned a Juno nomination for Adult Contemporary Album of the Year.

northsidebaby.bio: NorthSideBaby, born Dawson Pastion-Bear in High Level, Alberta, is an Indigenous Canadian rapper and producer from Dene Tha’ First Nation. After beginning as a teenage beatmaker, he moved into recording his own vocals and built a touring career that has taken him through communities and cities across Canada.

inderpal moga.bio: Canadian-Punjabi singer Inderpal Moga has become a prominent voice in contemporary Punjabi music through a run of melodic street records and collaborations with artists including Chani Nattan, AR Paisley, Dr Zeus and Jazzy B. His catalogue bridges Punjabi music with the sound and perspective of the Canadian diaspora.
